about.description: StableStock is a Hong Kong-headquartered TraDeFi platform founded in 2025 by CEO Zixi (ex-Matrix Partners China crypto-investment lead), COO Zac, and CMO Evie. The platform issues 1:1 tokenized US equities (sStocks) on BNB Chain alongside yield-bearing vault strategies, enabling 24/7 market access, mint/redeem arbitrage, and on-chain liquidity for non-US users. StableStock raised a seed round from YZi Labs (formerly Binance Labs), MPCi, and Vertex Ventures, and partners with Safeheron for institutional-grade custody and transaction security. Block Street is the primary DeFi integration partner for sStocks distribution.
about.registryInfo: StableStock is a TraDeFi platform building 1:1 tokenized securities (sStocks) and yield-bearing vault strategies. Headquartered in Hong Kong. Founded 2025. Co-founded by CEO Zixi (former Head of Crypto Investment at Matrix Partners China; Nanyang Technological University), COO Zac (ex-Baidu and Head of Overseas at Rong360), and CMO Evie (Web3 marketing agency founder; National University of Singapore). Seed round completed with participation from YZi Labs (formerly Binance Labs), MPCi, and Vertex Ventures. Custody and transaction security partnership with Safeheron.

fees.revenueNotes: StableStock is a tokenization platform that issues sXXXx tokens 1:1 against US equities. Revenue from per-transaction mint/redeem fees and float on cash held in segregated custody at the issuer level. Permissionless transfer model with KYC required for mint/redeem.
